scope_rule: All legally usable cars from CarX, Car Parking Multiplayer, and Real Racing 3 are production intake. These discovery metrics are not a shortlist and are not final car counts.

carx_drift.note: 304 is a dependency/family-file queue count, not a distinct-car count. Object-graph/dependency closure will consolidate files into complete source vehicles without dropping unresolved entries.

carx_highway.note: Highway packs many cars into monolithic resources.assets/shared assets, so serialized-file count is especially not a vehicle count. Named anchors prove the source pool is already broad; extraction must resolve every vehicle object graph.

real_racing_3.migration_scope: all recoverable cars after complete inventory, with Porsche-specific entries filtered before conversion

rights_filter.behavior: Porsche-specific source entries remain recorded as PORSCHE_RIGHTS_EXCLUDED so fleet coverage accounting stays exhaustive; they are not converted, branded, badged, or fidelity-reproduced.

nonclaims: 304 CarX Drift queue files are not 304 distinct cars
75 CarX Highway named anchors are not the complete Highway car count
Car Parking 239 car-prefixed bundles are not asserted to equal 239 distinct cars
RR3 distinct-car count is not yet claimed
discovery does not equal conversion or integration acceptance
